services.name: Sessions
services.desc: ROM’s popular ID Clinics are a great way to identify your mysterious found treasures, all while engaging with ROM staff and volunteers. Bring your rocks, minerals, gems, and fossils and ROM experts will help identify them for you. Clinics are free with RSVP. All participants are required to register for a ticket (kids included). Please note: no appraisals will be provided, or value ascribed to specimens brought to the ID clinics. ROM does not purchase specimens at these programs. ROM is unable to identify archaeological material as part of these clinics. ID Clinics run concurrently with ROM Third Tuesday Night Free (TTNF). services.name: Third Tuesday Nights Free
services.desc: Experience the Museum after hours - free for everyone - on the third Tuesday night of every month, from 4:00 PM to 8:30 PM. Enjoy access to most galleries and make an evening of discovery with friends and family. Special exhibitions are not included. Advance tickets are required, and walk-in entry is not available. To reserve your spot, click the “Book Tickets” button at the top of this page, select the third Tuesday of the month on the calendar, and choose “3rd Tuesday Nights Free.” Tickets are released two weeks before each event. services.desc: Stop by the Information Desk in Currelly Gallery, just south of the Futalognkosaurus (the BIG dinosaur just inside the main entry) where our volunteer ​Visitor Guides will be happy to offer map guides, brochures, directions, and suggestions.
